title: The generator's claim: each item at the lines of the work that give its Good, or waiting on a question; on a remake each item sent alone; asking before it makes anything, the items waiting alone; and each choice the work rests on that the CCS leaves open, with why.

items.description: one for each item of every checklist; on a remake, one for each item sent to you alone; before you have made anything, only the items that wait

questions.description: numbered from 1 in their order, [] where none

chosen.description: each choice the work rests on that neither the CCS nor the files it names gave, [] where none

made.description: an item made, at the lines of the work that give its Good

checklist.description: the checklist's path, as you were given it

item.description: the item's ID, such as B-1

lines.description: the lines of the work that give its Good, each range as `<path>:<from>-<to>`; for an item whose Scope is `each part`, at least one range in every part of the work, each inside one part

waits.description: an item only the user's answer can give its Good

checklist.description: the checklist's path, as you were given it

item.description: the item's ID, such as B-1

question.description: the number of the question it waits on

recommended.description: the answer you would choose, and why, in one sentence

choice.description: a choice you made that no one gave you

blocked.description: only where what keeps you from going on lies outside the work, such as a tool missing, a permission not given or a network blocked: the run then stops and tells its caller

needs.description: what you need to go on
